bundle.longDescription: GitSail Desktop is a local-first Git client built on a shared Rust core (GitSail's TUI and VS Code extension use the same core). It never requires a GitSail account and never sends telemetry. T-258/US-125 (EPIC-25): these metadata fields feed each platform's packaged installer (.deb/.rpm/.AppImage on Linux, .msi/NSIS .exe on Windows, .dmg/.app on macOS) — see docs/architecture/release-process.md for the packaging pipeline and the explicit, documented decision not to code-sign/notarize these installers yet.
